name: WW Donor Disc Reader
author: Dusklight WW crew (fork-local, never shipped)
description: L2: serves byte-identical donor files straight from the user's own Wind Waker (USA) disc image. Nothing staged, nothing shipped — zero-bake carried to completion. Configure mod.wwDonorDisc.wwIsoPath with the path to a plain GZLE01 .iso.
